name: PlaceReviews
text:
{"place_id": "ChIJhXNUstYXrjsR5go0eodkoQo", "review_count": 5, "reviews": [{"author": "p. pat", "rating": 4, "text": "This is a small specialty matcha shop with only max 8 seats, so it can be hard to find a place to sit when it’s busy. The shop itself is really cute and has a cozy vibe.
The drinks are quite pricey, though almost ₹400 per cup and the portions are pretty small. The cup is tiny and you can finish it in just a few sips. There aren’t many dessert options either; from what I saw, they only had cookies and matcha ice cream.

BUT the matcha is really good. It’s rich, flavorful, and clearly high quality, so matcha lovers will probably enjoy it.

I’d give it around 4–4.5 stars. Great matcha and a lovely atmosphere, but the shop is a bit too small and the prices are on the high side for the portion size. Still, it’s worth checking out if you’re a matcha fan.

One thing to keep in mind is that the seating is very limited. Because there are only about 8 seats, it doesn’t feel like the kind of place where you can stay for a long time, especially when other customers are waiting for a seat. You may feel a bit pressured to finish up and leave during busy hours.", "published": "2 months ago"}, {"author": "Rachna Shivale", "rating": 5, "text": "Completely in love with this place, their services, staff, overall vibes and most importantly their matchas! Ohh goodness how frothy, creamy and green the matcha is. Few more matchas will be added to the menu this week, and I was the first one to taste-test it! Grab it once you visit!", "published": "2 months ago"}, {"author": "Supriya Naidu", "rating": 5, "text": "The best matcha I’ve had in Bangalore! Intimate, adorable and just lovely! The matcha was high quality and the drinks were very well balanced. There’s a monsoon special menu now with fresh local fruits. I’m surely going back soon", "published": "a month ago"}, {"author": "Khushi Jana", "rating": 5, "text": "Highly recommend this place! Had the OG matcha and the Mango matcha. Both exceptionally good! You take a sip and you realize how high quality the matcha is! The very kind Miss and the other kind Mister who I am assuming is the owner, both were super sweet! They also guide anyone who is trying matcha for the first time, so you don’t have to stress over which one to get if you’re trying for the first time!
Definitely returning here if I comeback to Bangalore in the future!", "published": "3 months ago"}, {"author": "Tanish Sanghvi", "rating": 5, "text": "This is my favourite cafe for matcha. The cafe and the menu is so thoughtfully made, the matcha is so good. Everything they use is completely organic, they have a few fruit flavours for the matcha as well, they also have sushi and the matcha ice cream was so creamy and rich. The cafe is like a 2 - minutes walk from the indiranagar metro station.", "published": "2 months ago"}], "source": "google_places_api_new"}

name: PlaceReviews
text:
{"place_id": "ChIJsW3_iR4XrjsRf1-R-pEtIa4", "review_count": 5, "reviews": [{"author": "Snigdha Bhowmik", "rating": 5, "text": "Had the loveliest Friday brunch at Purpose Matcha+ Coffee House with a girlfriend, and it easily turned into one of our new favourite spots in the city. We tried a few dishes from their newly launched All Day Breakfast menu and everything was delicious. As a bacon fanatic, the Flapjacks and Bacon was the perfect comfort meal. The pancakes were light and fluffy, the eggs were cooked perfectly, and the bacon was absolutely worth it.

We also consider ourselves self-appointed matcha connoisseurs, so naturally we had to test the basics with their OG Matcha Latte and Matcha Cloud. The quality of the matcha genuinely stood out and felt far superior to many of the usual spots around the city. The Matcha Cloud, especially, was incredibly refreshing and perfect for the Bangalore heat.

The space itself is huge with plenty of seating, making it ideal for everything from peaceful work-from-cafe sessions to relaxed catch-ups with friends. The interiors are super aesthetic too, with lots of cozy corners and photo-worthy spots if you’re looking to click a few pictures while you’re there. They also have card games, books, and even a small loungewear section, which makes the whole experience feel much more thoughtful than just your average café visit.

Highly recommended visiting this wonderful place and can’t wait to go in again! 10/10", "published": "3 months ago"}, {"author": "DEEPTI RANI", "rating": 5, "text": "Love the vibe of the place. I’m a matcha person and their special summer matchas are too good to be true, even the food is amazing. Highly recommended.", "published": "4 months ago"}, {"author": "Natasha Sinha", "rating": 5, "text": "Absolutely loved the place, matcha, food & overall vibes! Super cute spot to come grab a beverage, eat some yummy food, play board games and even work out of! 👩🏻‍💻🍵🥐🍳", "published": "3 months ago"}, {"author": "Sundka Amber", "rating": 5, "text": "Absolutely loved my experience at PURPOSE Matcha. The space has such a calm, minimal, and elevated vibe perfect for slowing down and enjoying a mindful cup of matcha. Every drink felt thoughtfully crafted, with authentic flavours and great quality ingredients of matcha and the bites
Can’t wait to visit again.", "published": "2 months ago"}, {"author": "Piya", "rating": 5, "text": "Vibe, food, coffee - everything on point! I tried the chicken gyoza, kaya French toast and the Vietnamese iced coffee - all were fab. They also have coloring books and color pencils - such a refreshing experience! Definitely coming back for more.", "published": "2 months ago"}], "source": "google_places_api_new"}

blocks.summary: Since you're in Bengaluru and after premium matcha, here are the city's three dedicated matcha bars — each with a different vibe, from a tiny Indiranagar counter to a big brunch-ready space. All open now.
